latest_release.name: Concat v0.2.10
latest_release.body:
## Concat 0.2.10

### Fixed

- **Captions on Windows.** Generating captions no longer closes the app as it starts (#667, #668, #673).
- **Black preview with Chroma Key.** On some Windows PCs the Chroma Key effect could leave every preview black and exports failing. That cause is fixed (#673). A black preview that has nothing to do with Chroma Key is still open; if you see one on 0.2.10, please add your log to #709.
- When the graphics driver drops out mid-session, Concat notices straight away and tries again every two seconds, not on every frame (#673).
- Titles, captions and shapes play their In, Out and Loop animations, and an animation picked in the Animate panel sticks (#369).
- A speed curve plays smoothly, without a stutter every tenth of a second.
- The Library's sidebar scrolls, so Audio Effects can be reached under Video Effects.
- The New Project sheet scrolls in a short window and its shapes wrap in a narrow one (#688, #689, #693).
- The missing media dialog fits its files, closes from its ×, and each missing file has a Remove.
- The inspector keeps Voice only and No voice (#120).

### New

- **In, Out and Loop animations** for clips, pictures, titles and shapes, picked from a wall of cards that play their moves (#369).
- **Voice isolation.** Keep a clip's voice alone or take it out, from a song's music or a recording's noise, each part at its own level (#120).
- **Shake & Motion.** Shake, Impact, Beat Shake and Prism Shake on a shelf of their own.
- **A stack of masks per clip**, each with its own mode and keyframes (#489).
- **Shapes you can edit**: size, corners, polygons, stars, gradients, outlines, line ends, trim and shadow (#288).
- Fades follow a curve you can hear and see, with a red zone on the fader and every waveform.
- The speed curve graph is taller, sits on a labelled grid, and lets you pick several points at once.
- Caption language presets for Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali, Thai, Vietnamese, Russian, Ukrainian and Greek (#675).
- Generate Captions lives in the Library, under Text & Captions.
- Your computer stays awake, and your phone's screen stays on, while a job runs (#695).
- Enhance takes any scale up to 2K, shows a progress bar, and says what it will make before it starts.
- A setting that only takes effect at launch offers a restart, which saves and reopens your project.
- The panels and the window open where you left them.

### Faster

- Titles and captions no longer freeze the window: they are painted in the background, about 45 times faster than before (#261).
- Effects are ready when the window opens, so the first time you use one it does not stall.
- Exports read each clip ahead of its cut.
- Filmstrips of long footage appear sooner.

### Interface

- A new Welcome screen, with a What's new card.
- The Audio tab is rebuilt around a gain fader, a stem mixer and fades drawn on the sound (#120).
- Settings is a page over the whole window, as Export is.
- Layers, effects, grades and transitions each have a colour of their own.
- OK comes before Cancel on Windows, and after it on macOS and Linux (#681).
- Dragging past the timeline's edge scrolls gently or fast depending on how far you go, and the scrollbar is bigger (#633, #634).
- Fourteen looks have new names.

### For agents and scripts

- `concat --schema` prints the whole API as JSON Schema.
- An agent can give a clip a stack of masks and keyframe each one.
- `concat preview` draws an effect at any instant of its clip (`--moment`) and a transition at any point of its cut (`--progress`).
- If a graphics driver misreports its memory, `CONCAT_GPU_BUDGET=off` lifts the limit Concat sets from it.

### Before you install

- **Windows:** this release is not code-signed yet. SmartScreen asks before it runs: **More info** › **Run anyway**. Where Smart App Control is on, Windows refuses unsigned programs; see the [code signing policy](https://github.com/jub0t/concat/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md).
- **Android:** no automated
